cards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE square full-bleed character illustration for Project: Prowl's established medieval elemental cat CARD ART COLLECTION. Produce artwork only: no frame, UI, lettering, names, numbers, border, watermark or signature.
Art direction: an original 2D fantasy-adventure production cartoon, matching the current collection's bold warm-black outlines, thinner purposeful interior lines, matte flat colour masses and simple hard-edged cel shadows. Each material has one base colour, at most one flat shadow and one small flat highlight. Do not use painterly shading, hatching, distressed grain, individual fur strands, realistic lighting, bloom or glossy 3D. Props, cloth, stone and elemental effects are simple graphic shapes. Same finish ceiling as the existing cards, not a different artist's more detailed rendering.
Feline proportions: compact stubby cats with oversized expressive heads, big eyes, short broad muzzles, short necks, rounded torsos, broad feline haunches and SHORT limbs. No adult human proportions, human waist, human fingers, long arms or human footwear. Exactly one head, one torso, ONE tail, TWO forelegs and TWO hind legs. Every foreleg traces clearly from shoulder to paw to prop contact. Holding paws REPLACE planted forepaws, never add extra arms. Every hind paw is visibly connected to a haunch; use deliberate negative space around overlaps. Paws are simple mitten-like grouped cat shapes with at most three broad toe divisions, no opposing human thumbs.
Composition: square 1254 by 1254, full character and props within the canvas. Head large in the upper-middle; both eyes visible, kept clear of the upper-left element badge and upper-right Power badge zones. Main action directly below the face so it remains identifiable in a shallow landscape card crop. Simple low-depth background with one large flat elemental circle and at most three broad supporting motifs. No distant silhouettes, castles, extra characters or tiny clutter.

Subject: Charmae Hearthstitch, a female Fire Uncommon Rally seamstress. A solid warm chocolate-brown Havana Brown cat, GREEN eyes, broad rounded cheek shapes, a slightly raised eyebrow and a confident closed-mouth mischievous smile. No tabby stripes or colourpoint mask. Compact adult feline build, not tall or human-shaped.
Costume: a short rust-red medieval wool work dress tailored around her round cat torso and haunches, broad ochre cuffs, a brown fitted leather waist belt and ONE small sewing pouch. The skirt ends above her paws and opens around her seated hind legs. A broad simple ochre collar and a few large tailoring seams only. No cape, scarf, modern buttons, zippers or random jewellery.
Action: seated on her haunches beside a LOW wooden workbench, three-quarter toward the viewer. A single red cloth banner lies across the bench and drapes over its near edge. BOTH short forelegs are plainly visible: one rounded paw gently pins the banner's torn edge to the bench, the other holds ONE simple boat-shaped wooden weaving shuttle immediately above the repair, drawing a single thick golden thread through the seam. The shuttle is one continuous wooden object with rounded ends; the paw grip must be readable, not a human hand. Exactly TWO hind legs under her short skirt, each with a distinct chocolate rear paw on the ground; not extra planted forelegs. One smooth chocolate cat tail curves out beside the bench, separate from all four limbs. Two or three small orange sparks follow the freshly repaired golden seam without hiding her paws.
Backdrop/palette: warm cream field with one flat brick-red circle behind her. Only the low wooden bench, two neatly folded fabric bundles at its far end, and a simple broad ground shadow. Strong readable silhouette, friendly craftsperson personality, same clean collection style. No loom machinery, sewing machine, needle clutter, banner text, heraldic logos or additional tools.
